observation.visible_scene: Top-down view of a single circular orange slice floating on a blue water surface. The slice shows radial segments, a pale pith center, and two seeds. Small air bubbles cluster mainly along the slice's lower rim, with a few scattered elsewhere; the background water shows moving ripples and light reflections.
visible_changes: The slice rotates slowly: the two central seeds shift from a roughly vertical (top/bottom) alignment in the first frames to a roughly horizontal (left/right) alignment by the last frames.
The slice drifts upward within the frame; its top edge moves from clearly below the top border to nearly touching/being cropped by the top, with a slight rightward shift.
The slice's apparent size remains essentially constant (only minor change).

A small group of bubbles stays adjacent to the lower rim throughout, while individual bubbles elsewhere change position, appear, or disappear (e.g., right-side bubbles present early are gone later; new bubbles emerge at upper right).
The water-surface ripple and reflection pattern continuously changes across the background.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the slice's translation and rotation (current, contact, etc.).
How the slice entered this view and what occurs after the excerpt ends.
uncertain_details: Whether the upward drift is object motion or camera movement (background evidence is insufficient to separate them).
The exact direction/sense of the slice's rotation.
Whether the bubbles near the rim are attached to the slice or free-floating.
Whether the slice's slight size change is due to zoom or perspective.
